message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: illegal fundraising (非法吸收公众存款) by P2P platform, fraudulent investment contracts, false promises, misappropriation. Also possibly fraud (诈骗) because they induced public to invest with false promises. In Chinese criminal law, illegal fundraising (非法吸收公众存款罪) is separate from fraud (诈骗罪). The description: they attracted public to invest, promised high returns, used false projects. That's classic illegal fundraising. Also they used false contracts, false risk monitoring, etc. The individual business person Wang (汪某) as a salesperson, illegal fundraising amount 870 million? Actually 870万. So charge: illegal absorption of public deposits. Also possibly "诈骗" (fraud) because they defrauded investors. In many cases, both charges can be applied: illegal fundraising and fraud. In examples, they often list both: e.g., earlier example "非法吸收公众存款;诈骗". So answer likely includes both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法吸收公众存款;诈骗<eoa>
